subject: Hosted API: request for flexible commit & per-token discount path
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nova-ai.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing ask: flex commit + blended per-token for Nova AI pilot

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Nova is excited to move from PoC to a short production pilot. Quick ask from procurement: we’re hoping Redwood can offer a blended per-token rate for a 12-month commitment with a soft ramp in Q1. Rough forecast attached (nova_volume_forecast.xlsx) — baseline is ~6M tokens/month initially, ramp to ~450M/month by month 6 (see tab "token_curve").

What we had in mind: a 12-month commit with a ~50% utilization floor and a blended per-token price in the neighborhood of $0.0008/token for the committed volume (your hosted rate card shows $0.0012/token for our projected band). If Redwood needs a different structure (commit tiers + true-up), happy to consider.

Can you confirm what documentation you need (PO, SOC2 evidence, billing contact)? We’d like to kick off contracting this month if possible.

Attachments: nova_volume_forecast.xlsx (forecast)

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform
Nova AI
elena.ruiz@nova-ai.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nova-ai.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing ask: flex commit + blended per-token for Nova AI pilot

Elena —

Thanks for the forecast and the clear ask. Two quick notes: (1) we can structure a 12-month commit with ramp and a utilization floor, and (2) custom blended slabs will need an exception approval if they sit below our published rate bands.

Two options up front to discuss internally and with you:

- Option A (Commit slab): 12-month commit, 5B tokens annualized, blended price $0.00085/token with a 90-day ramp and quarterly true-up.
- Option B (Pilot concession): 90-day pilot at an 8% discount to published rate for up to 500M tokens, then revert to rate card or move to a commit slab based on actuals.

To escalate the commit slab we’ll need: the attached forecast (provided), procurement contact, and confirmation of whether Nova requires invoicing by PO vs. monthly card. Karthik, Ben — I’m looping you for pricing/approval guidance and to flag finance/billing implications.

Elena — can you share the procurement contact and any preferred contract terms (net30, PO, billing email)? I’ll push this through pricing committee today.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Office: +1 (415) 555-0199

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing ask: flex commit + blended per-token for Nova AI pilot

Tessa —

Thanks for the summary. My initial view: Option B (pilot concession) is an easy path to close quickly; Option A (deep blended slab at $0.00085) is plausible but requires an exception route. Quick internal guardrails:

- For commit slabs that go below $0.0009/token we need explicit approval from Marissa (SVP) because it materially changes unit economics.
- Approve pilot concession up to 10% off rate card without escalation if ACV < $75k and no advanced commitments.
- For any year-long blended slab we require a 3-month ramp clause and a quarterly true-up plus an early termination true-up (standard).

Request for Tessa: please attach the forecast (they did), procurement contact, and projected ACV run-rate so I can estimate P&L impact. Also include whether they need SOC 2 or contract redlines. I’ll draft an internal memo for Pricing Committee and mark this as high priority.

Karthik
Director, Commercial Strategy
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing ask: flex commit + blended per-token for Nova AI pilot

Team —

I reviewed the forecast and Karthik’s synopsis. FYI on approval thresholds: I can approve a time-bound pilot concession up to 12% off published rate for an initial (<=90 day) period without requiring the full pricing committee. For any deeper, multi-quarter blended slab that implies a long-term revenue concession (below $0.0009/token on projected annualized usage), I need to see:

- Confirmed volume forecast and ACV (see nova_volume_forecast.xlsx)
- Procurement terms (PO vs. prepay vs. net30)
- SOC 2 / legal checklist (security/compliance sign-off)
- Finance sign-off on revenue recognition and billing cadence

If Nova wants the blended $0.00085/token for a 12-month commit we will need a formal pricing committee review and likely VP-level signoff because that materially widens the discount. Please route the forecast + the proposed contract (we need a draft MSA) and I’ll prioritize a committee slot.

Attach the forecast in the PRD to the ticket and cc finance (ben) when you have the procurement contact.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
SVP Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: nova_volume_forecast.xlsx (reviewed)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nova-ai.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing ask: flex commit + blended per-token for Nova AI pilot

Elena —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Based on internal guidance here is a suggested mutual action plan to keep momentum:

1) Sign 90-day pilot MSA (draft attached: nova_msa_draft.pdf via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123). Pilot terms: up to 500M tokens total; 8% off published rate; standard SLA and SOC2 evidence to be provided.
2) During pilot we’ll monitor usage and cadence; if Nova meets the ramp profile we’ll fast-track Pricing Committee for a 12-month blended slab.
3) Procurement ask: please confirm billing preference (PO vs. invoice) and provide procurement contact name and email so we can prepare an invoice template.

If this works I’ll initiate the DocuSign and request Marissa signoff for the pilot concession (she’s looped). Procurement — feel free to pull Ben in on billing details.

Best,
Tessa
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.com

--- Forwarded message attached: nova_msa_draft.pdf (DocuSign link)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2026 17:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval: one-time pilot concession for Nova AI (conditional)

Team —

I’m approving a one-time pilot concession as described in Tessa’s note: 90 days, up to 500M tokens, 10% off published rate (slightly higher than Tessa suggested) provided the following conditions are met:

1) Nova signs the MSA via DocuSign within 10 business days.
2) Nova provides the procurement contact and either a PO or prepay for month 1.
3) SOC2 attestation is acknowledged; any outstanding compliance items are added to the procurement checklist.
4) We include a 30-day post-pilot review clause and a true-up for under-utilization.

Finance (Ben) — please prepare the invoice template and confirm revenue recognition implications. Karthik — please schedule Pricing Committee if Nova requests the deeper 12-month blended slab at ~$0.00085/token.

Marissa Cole
SVP Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
